reviews.text: 300+ dollars just to be seen is ridiculous. “It includes three type of exams” or whatever in which can be done at a regular office and I don’t need them BECAUSE they did those at a regular vet, exam behind the cornea(just looking with a light), tear and scratch test, done at a steep price already at the regular vet. I guess her eyes are just going to fall out or go blind! Super helpful!!

Dr. Reed and her team are fantastic! From the moment I called for an appointment to the end of our visit, the staff was helpful, thoughtful and informative. My kitten presented with a ruptured eye and they were able to move my appointment up to see him sooner. The office was clean and everyone made us feel very welcome and comfortable. Dr. Reed addressed my questions and relieved my concerns and presented all options for my kitten’s treatment, including options that could be performed outside her office. I felt that she always had my kitten’s best interest and safety at heart. Thank you everyone for your help! I have been spreading the word about how awesome you all are 😁
Dr. Reed is amazing. I wish she could be our regular vet! We adore this specialty office. The team is just as special!

Dr. Reed is a excellent Eye specialist! Our savannah cat zephyr is doing good and his eyes have improved. I could not be more pleased with the delight she brought us and the sigh of relief as we walked through the doors of the eye specialists practice.

Amazing is one of the few words that come to mind. We brought a little guy in to see Dr. Reed as our vet informed us that both eyes should be removed. Within a few minutes our minds were put at ease. Dr. Reed provided great information in a way that was easy to understand which we really appreciated. Our little guy has been sent home with a change up of medication and a check up in a month.
This is what a professional operation looks like. Job well done

I can't say enough great things about Dr. Zoe & her staff!!! Truly feel like this is a family vet. EVERYONE we encountered was amazing and very understanding of the stress & trauma we all may be experiencing when we come in. My 11 yr old pup had a cactus spine lodged into her cornea and Ara & Dr. Zoe were able to pull it out with minimal stress & without sedating her. They are understanding of high expenses and aren't pushy about extras or upselling- very much appreciated. Kyia is about 1.5 months out and her corneal scar is minimal to the human eye and she's back to her best. THANK YOU ❤️🙏🏼

Probably the best doctors visit experience in my life! Would highly recommend! Took my dog in for a weird dilated eye, and the doctor probably spent 45 minutes with us explaining every test, my dog's scores, what that means, and anatomy of the dog's eye. Left very informed and reassured! Great staff all around, kind, patient, and accommodating!

Dr. Reed and the entire staff at Eyeshine Veterinary are fantastic! From the moment you enter the lobby, the front desk staff are warm and caring, and everyone from the vet techs to Dr. Reed herself make you and your pet feel at ease and well taken care of. Our dog was suffering from a corneal ulcer, and his pain was promptly taken care of and an effective treatment plan was developed. I would often call into the office with questions during his treatment and was always met with professionalism and a reassuring response. After each treatment and follow-up visit, I was promptly emailed a summary of the appointment and instructions for my dog's care, which made tracking everything very clear and easy. I can't recommend Eyeshine Veterinary enough!

We had the best experience with Dr. Zoe Reed and her team at Eyeshine. Their bedside manner was exceptional, they were extremely comprehensive in their assessment of our good boy, and they did everything they could to maintain the vision he had in his old age. They communicated efficiently and effectively and were a pleasure to work with. Hopefully your dog doesn't ever have significant eye problems, but if they do, I couldn't recommend this specialist enough - they are truly the best. Thanks to the Eyeshine team for helping us keep our boy taken well care of for so many of his later years!! You all rock!!!

We had a wonderful experience at Eyeshine Ophthalmology with Dr. Zoe Reed and her team. The small details really stood out and made the visit feel welcoming. The office is comfortable, they offered beverages, and after Patches’ first appointment they even mailed us a welcome card, which was such a thoughtful touch.

Dr. Reed took the time to answer all of my questions and never made the appointment feel rushed. Patches seemed very comfortable with her, which says a lot because he can be picky. He loved the dried beef liver treats they had (and he is normally a treat snob who refuses treats from anyone else!). I will definitely be buying him some beef liver treats now since he liked them so much.

I also really appreciated that Dr. Reed did not push unnecessary diagnostics and took a thoughtful, balanced approach to his care.

It is also inspiring to see such a well-run woman-owned private veterinary ophthalmology practice. We are very grateful to have found Dr. Reed and her team and highly recommend Eyeshine Ophthalmology.
I cannot recommend Dr. Reed enough. Her office staff and assistants are all incredible as well. They took such great care of chompsky! Thank you for saving his vision!
Ara and Dr. Reid are incredible. They provide so much education, care and are so compassionate and kind during a stressful series of events.
Loved Eyeshine Vet, staff was great and Dr Zoe Reed was the best. 👍👍 glad they were recommend to us.

Just took our younger Australian Shepherd to Eyeshine today. We received the same outstanding service as with our other Aussie back in May. Dr. Reed and her staff provide the best experience for dogs from initially walking in the door through diagnosis and treatment. Once again, a complete explanation. Eyeshine gets my highest recommendation.

Dr.Reed and her team were great.The waiting room was nicely decorated.Feels like we were in someone's living room,Dr.Reed was able to explain my dog's eye condition using an ipad  which is easier to understand than difficult medical terms.Instead of worrying about his eye condition,I made a good decision.Piece of mind is worth a million. .Thank you Dr.Reed.

It is too bad that ratings only go to a 5.  We would rate Eyeshine Veterinary a 10!!! We recently took our poodle to Eyeshine Veterinary for a second opinion, after we were told that he would have to have his eye surgically removed.  Prior to this first visit, we were unaware that there even was a specialty for animal ophthamology.  Wow!  Our ophthamologist was extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and kind.  Her support team were all great.  We were so impressed with the facility, the team approach to patient care, the time they took with us, and the plan going forward.  Bottom line - EYE SAVED!!! We definitely recommend Eyeshine Veterinary!

This place is amazing the staff is amazing and the Dr Reed is amazing and so informative and they literally made my week❤️ I’ve been so stressed out about my dog Lily who is 19 years old and I was told by my vet that i should start thinking about putting her to sleep and I was so heartbroken and couldn’t sleep for a week till my appointment today and now I’m so happy and I feel like a ton of bricks has been lifted off of me, thank you eyeshine you all are so wonderful Lily and I love you all.

When our 8 yr old Australian Shepherd Zak developed a bulge on his eye we took him in to see Dr. Reed. She and her staff are a strong team! Immediate diagnosis, fulsome explanation, followed by a successful plan of action.  Eyeshine Veterinary has high highest  rating!
Unwilling to provide a price range for the service I requested.

I would give a one star but thankfully you have other staff that was friendly enough to answer my questions. The first staff member I spoke with was extremely unprofessional as soon as I reasked a question to better understand the policy. It was clearly an inconvenience to her even stating she has other customers she needed to deal with (Then why did you answer the phone if your so busy?) I was simply trying to get a broad range 20k, 10k, 5k of what I should expect vs paying for the initial appointment and maybe getting told it 30k. After I reasked my question she was extremely defensive and rude speaking over me then just hung up. I suggest one business owner to another she needs more training on customer service or don't have her answer phones. She even stated she was having a great day i would hate to see how she treats customers when she is having a bad day.

Super informative and went over multiple options.  She was a 2nd opinion and was so glad I went to eyeshine!

What a great experience with Dr. Reed and her team!

From the friendly front desk staff, to the amazing techs who handled my nervous …
